7.4.3.4.2.2 Routine Control proxy
The routine control proxy provides access to routine control services in Ap-
plication Software Clusters, which can be accessed by UDS diagnostic ser-
vices 0x31 RoutineControl via the Dcm in the Host Software Cluster.
